blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The water levels of five out of nine monitored dams across the country have risen slightly over the past 24 hours, according to the weather bureau. In its latest update issued at 8 a.m., the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) observed an increase in the water levels of Ipo, Angat, Caliraya, Ambuklao, and Pantabangan.
